group.name: Payment Gateway <-> Order Module
group.modules: Order Module (orders.js: createOrder, calculateTotal)  <->  Payment Module (payment.js: processPayment)  <->  Product Module (reduceStock)
group.strategy: Incremental Integration: Product module + Order module were combined first, then the Payment gateway was added and the combined flow re-tested.
group.dataPassed: Order -> Payment: {amount = calculated total, cardNumber, expiry, cvv};  Payment -> Order: {ok, payment.id, status};  Order -> Product: (productId, qty) for stock reduction

cases.title: Successful payment creates PAID order and reduces stock
cases.objective: Verify the order module charges through the payment gateway and only updates stock/orders when payment succeeds
cases.pre: DB seeded (stock: Mouse=10, Keyboard=5, Cable=50); user logged in
cases.expected: status 201, total 3000, order PAID, payment SUCCESS, Mouse stock 10 -> 8
cases.actual: status 201, total 3000, order PAID, payments ["SUCCESS"], stock [8,5,50]

cases.title: Declined payment creates no order and keeps stock
cases.objective: Verify the order module charges through the payment gateway and only updates stock/orders when payment succeeds
cases.pre: DB seeded (stock: Mouse=10, Keyboard=5, Cable=50); user logged in
cases.expected: status 402, 0 orders, payment DECLINED, stock unchanged [10,5,50]

cases.title: Discounted total (>10,000) is what the gateway charges
cases.objective: Verify the order module charges through the payment gateway and only updates stock/orders when payment succeeds
cases.pre: DB seeded (stock: Mouse=10, Keyboard=5, Cable=50); user logged in

cases.title: Insufficient stock is detected before charging the card
cases.objective: Verify the order module charges through the payment gateway and only updates stock/orders when payment succeeds
cases.pre: DB seeded (stock: Mouse=10, Keyboard=5, Cable=50); user logged in
cases.expected: status 409, no payment recorded, stock unchanged
cases.actual: status 409, ["Insufficient stock for Mechanical Keyboard"], payments [], stock [10,5,50]

cases.title: Same product in two cart lines exceeding stock is refused without charging
cases.objective: Verify the order module charges through the payment gateway and only updates stock/orders when payment succeeds
cases.pre: DB seeded (stock: Mouse=10, Keyboard=5, Cable=50); user logged in
cases.expected: status 409 "Insufficient stock", no payment recorded, stock stays 10
